      About this item

      • ✅ NABHI — CENTRE OF 72,000 NADIS — According to Ayurveda, the navel is the origin of 72,000 nadis (energy channels) connecting every organ in the body. Digestion & Detox Nabhi Oil applied here travels through these channels directly to the digestive tract, liver, and gut — activating detoxification and improving digestion from within, without pills or churan.
      • ✅ INSTANT BLOATING & GAS RELIEF — Formulated with Hing (Asafoetida), Ajwain, and digestive herbs clinically used in Ayurveda as medicine for gas and acidity. Provides fast relief from a full, heavy stomach and hyperacidity without side effects.
      • ✅14-DAY GUT CLEANSE & DETOX — Acts as a daily gut cleaner — use every night to support gut health, remove accumulated toxins, and restore your digestive rhythm. Ideal as an Ayurvedic gut health supplement for long-term gut care.
      • ✅100% AYURVEDIC, NO CHEMICALS — Pure herbal formula with cold-pressed oils and Ayurvedic herbs. A safe alternative to acidity syrup, digestion syrup, or gas medicine — suitable for adults and children above 5. No mineral oil, no parabens, no artificial fragrance.
      • ✅ VED SANJEEVANI PROMISE — Just 6 drops on the belly button at bedtime. Non-sticky, fast-absorbing formula. 4.5★ rated by thousands of customers. Trusted Ayurvedic brand with verified ingredients and dermatologist-approved formulation. 30ml bottle lasts 30+ days.

      • Is the product safe to use?

        Yes, it is formulated by experts. Perform a patch test before first use. Apply a small amount on skin and wait 20 minutes. If no irritation occurs, it is safe to continue using.

      • How should I use the product correctly?

        Apply 4–5 drops in your belly button daily before bedtime. Gently massage in a circular motion for better absorption. Clean the area in the morning as per instructions.

      • How long does it take to show results?

        With daily use before bedtime, results may be visible within 21 days. Outcomes may vary depending on individual body type and consistency.

      • What is the shelf life of the product?

        The shelf life is up to 18 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

      • Are there any side effects?

        Made with natural ingredients. However, results may vary. If irritation occurs, discontinue use and consult a professional.

          But this Digestion Nabhi Oil has taken that age-old wisdom to an entirely new level.

          From the very first use, I could feel its potency. Within ten minutes, I experienced noticeable relief—gases started releasing effortlessly, and the heaviness in the stomach began melting away. The effect is almost instant, yet beautifully gentle.

          What I appreciate even more is that the oil doesn’t just work on bloating or gas; it supports the entire digestive system.           The texture is smooth, the aroma is comforting, and just a few drops go a long way. It feels like a perfect blend of tradition and modern wellness—simple, pure, and deeply effective.

          In short, this oil is nothing less than a little bottle of magic. If you believe in natural remedies and want quick relief with long-lasting benefits, this is one product you can trust wholeheartedly.

        About this Item

        • ✅ NABHI — CENTRE OF 72,000 NADIS — According to Ayurveda, the navel is the origin of 72,000 nadis (energy channels) connecting every organ in the body. Digestion & Detox Nabhi Oil applied here travels through these channels directly to the digestive tract, liver, and gut — activating detoxification and improving digestion from within, without pills or churan.
        • ✅ INSTANT BLOATING & GAS RELIEF — Formulated with Hing (Asafoetida), Ajwain, and digestive herbs clinically used in Ayurveda as medicine for gas and acidity. Provides fast relief from a full, heavy stomach and hyperacidity without side effects.
        • ✅14-DAY GUT CLEANSE & DETOX — Acts as a daily gut cleaner — use every night to support gut health, remove accumulated toxins, and restore your digestive rhythm. Ideal as an Ayurvedic gut health supplement for long-term gut care.
        • ✅100% AYURVEDIC, NO CHEMICALS — Pure herbal formula with cold-pressed oils and Ayurvedic herbs. A safe alternative to acidity syrup, digestion syrup, or gas medicine — suitable for adults and children above 5. No mineral oil, no parabens, no artificial fragrance.
        • ✅ VED SANJEEVANI PROMISE — Just 6 drops on the belly button at bedtime. Non-sticky, fast-absorbing formula. 4.5★ rated by thousands of customers. Trusted Ayurvedic brand with verified ingredients and dermatologist-approved formulation. 30ml bottle lasts 30+ days.

        Product description

        Ved Sanajeevani Digestion & Detox Nabhi Oil is an Ayurvedic wellness blend crafted to support healthy digestion through traditional nabhya dhara application. Designed to be applied directly to belly button area, this fast-absorbing herbal oil helps ease bloating, gas, heaviness, and abdominal discomfort while supporting daily digestive balance. Its carefully selected botanical oils and herbs work gently overnight to help relax stomach area, promote smoother digestion, and encourage better nutrient absorption. This 30ml bottle offers a simple, non-invasive addition to your nighttime self-care routine. Just apply 6 drops before sleep and let nourishing ingredients absorb through navel area, a key Ayurvedic marma point associated with internal balance. Unlike harsh detox products or frequent antacid use, this oil provides a soothing approach that supports metabolism and natural cleansing without disrupting your routine. Formulated with traditional digestive herbs such as Hing and Ajwain, this blend helps reduce occasional fullness after meals and supports comfort during everyday digestive stress. Its non-sticky texture absorbs quickly, making it convenient for regular use. Free from mineral oil, parabens, and artificial fragrance, it is made to suit daily wellness needs. Whether you experience occasional bloating, irregular digestion, or simply want to maintain gut comfort naturally, Ved Sanajeevani Nabhi Oil offers a practical Ayurvedic solution. Consistent use may help you feel lighter, more comfortable, and better supported from within. Trusted herbal care in an easy nightly ritual, this nabhi oil brings traditional digestive support into modern lifestyles.

        Important Information

        Safety Information:

        Patch Test Recommended

        Ingredients:

        Carom Seeds, Fennel Seeds, Peppermint, Black Cumin Seed

        Directions:

        Before bed, apply 6 drops of Nabhi oil to your belly button and massage in a circular clockwise motion. Repeat at least 3 times a week, and remember to clean your belly button in the morning for best results.
